purpose: Bounded coordinate evidence for optional RAW surface envelope diagnostics. Native BIN label contact remains authoritative; this is not independent registration or a surface-to-voxel ID map.
scope: Only the twelve named case IDs at frame 1, startslice 1, with verified parameter geometry and a content-matching local XCAT generator.

centerline_method_reference.implementation_scope: FakeCT implements a conservative bounded topology proof inspired by DPI. It uses exhaustive graph-distance ring layers, accepts only simple ring cycles, and falls back when proof fails; it is not the full adaptive DPI surface pipeline.
